_why: RAY OF SICKNESS smoke test (2026-11-08). Swaps the Cadre Force-Weaver's slot 4 from Jump to Ray of Sickness. Forces the d20 high so the attack roll hits, then watches whether 2d8 poison landed and whether the per-slot disadvantage flag (the Poisoned stand-in) got set on the target.
label: dev_scene_select

stats.wizard_spell_4_desc: Ray of Sickness—a sickly green ray of raw poison that leaves whatever it strikes nauseated and reeling long after the light fades.
